label: baseline-validation
method: Paired same-position comparison with actual Chess.com rapid 800-1000 human moves. Eight fixed bot seeds, normal 75ms worker compute budget, Stockfish 19 Lite depth 10 independent unrestricted/forced root searches, cleared hash each search. Loss capped at 1000cp including mate transitions. Games split before tuning. This measures move quality on this corpus, not a competitive platform rating. No skipped positions or failures.
